answer.rationale: Memory 57 is strongest because it explicitly reports qualified revenue gains with no measured retention harm, directly addressing both revenue quality and sustainability. Memory 44 is strong evidence of higher-quality enterprise pipeline, though it does not establish closed-won revenue, retention, or unit economics. Memories 31 and 86 show durable or broad early-adoption improvements, which are plausible leading indicators but omit downstream monetization and retention. Memory 73 reports acquisition and revenue lift in the relevant price-sensitive SMB segment, but omits margin, retention, and durability under competitive pricing. Memory 91 only establishes improved week-one engagement and first meaningful action, with no evidence of conversion, revenue quality, retention, or durable effects.
